verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for an online government service portal, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an AI or virtual assistant inside USCIS online accounts or uscis.gov. The documented features are form filing with static tips, case-status tools, an eligibility questionnaire, Torch developer APIs, and G-28 delegation to human attorneys or representatives, none of which is delegating tasks to a built-in AI assistant.
